list.title: Quotes
list.intro: Every quote with what it is worth and what is still to be paid. Make a quote from a lead's page.
list.empty: No quotes yet. Open a lead and choose New quote.

lead.title: Quotes
lead.none: No quote yet. Make one with the plan and the price, then send its link on WhatsApp.

quote.title: Quote
quote.notFound: This quote doesn't exist, or isn't yours to see.
quote.whatsappWords: Hi {name}, here is your quote for {title}. You can see the plan, pay by UPI and accept it here: {link}
quote.noPhone: This customer has no phone number. Copy the link and send it another way.
quote.deleteDescription: It goes from the lead and from Quotes. Its link stops working.
quote.optionMade: Another option made. Change its hotel or price; the customer's link shows both.
quote.versionMade: A new draft was made. The old quote's link now says it was replaced.
quote.frozenTitle: This quote was sent, so its prices are fixed
quote.frozenBody: To change anything, make a new version: a draft copy that replaces this quote. The customer's old link then says it was replaced.
quote.replacedBody: A new version took its place. Its old link tells the customer so.
quote.acceptedByOn: {name} accepted this on {when}. It is now the booking, so its prices can't change.
quote.acceptedSentence: This quote was accepted on {when}. It is now the booking, so its prices can't change.

form.title: Quote title
form.noDays: No days yet. Add each day's plan: where, what, which hotel.
form.noItems: No price yet. Add the package, hotel, cab, activities.
form.taxRateHint: Tour operators usually charge 5% on the whole package without input credit.
form.inclusionsHint: What the price includes: hotels, meals, transfers.
form.exclusionsHint: What it doesn't: flights, entry fees, personal expenses.
form.notesHint: Anything else the customer should know.
form.placeOfSupplyHint: Decides CGST and SGST, or IGST. Leave as your own state unless the customer is in another state or outside India.

money.title: Payments
money.noInstallments: No payment schedule. Add the advance and the balance with their dates.
money.voidDescription: It stays in the audit log, but no longer counts as paid.
money.installmentDescription: What the customer pays and by when.
money.paymentDescription: Money the customer paid you. The quote is accepted and the lead won.

paymentForm.referenceHint: The UPI transaction id or cheque number, if any.

settings.title: Quotes and payments
settings.intro: Customers pay you straight to your UPI id from their quote's link. The money never passes through us.
settings.upiIdHint: Like yourname@okhdfcbank. Leave it empty to hide Pay by UPI.
settings.upiNameHint: The name the customer's UPI app shows.
settings.taxRateHint: A new quote starts with it.
settings.termsHint: Payment and cancellation terms. Empty uses your branding's terms.

dashboard.title: Money

dashboard.overdueCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing late} one {# quote late} other {# quotes late}}

package.saved: Package saved. Use it from any lead's New quote.

package.description: Keep this plan and price under a name, to make the next lead's quote in one tap.
package.name: Package name

package.listIntro: Your ready packages. A lead's New quote starts from any of them in one tap.
